items.title: Bernie Kirsh interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 27, 2022
items.q: I wanted to speak about this project that you’ve been involved with with Glenn Zottola.

ctx.x: Well it depends on what the situation is. I mean I could have a difference of opinion about something and I would approach it in a way that wouldn’t be encroaching, you know, the task is probably a greater amount of personal interaction — how shall I say — how to work with others, and how to keep things on an even keel in the control room and so forth, as much as it is a technical activity.

I wanted to speak about this project that you’ve been involved with with Glenn Zottola. It’s wonderful that Chick’s legacy is continuing. And some of these recordings are really marvelous and it’s nice that Glenn was there when Chick wanted to reach out. And apparently Chick would call him up very late and say, “What are you doing? Come on over.”

Yeah I know that was him. It’s playing, just total playing. And they would do that. Yeah I mean they play great — Glenn is just a marvelous musician, just incredible. And he and Chick got along so well that way. And you can hear it in that recording. So great camaraderie there.
